svg.title: Aegis Measure system architecture
svg.desc: Four services — web dashboard, api, reference-assistant, and Postgres — plus an external CI/CD trigger, an LLM provider, and an optional outbound alert webhook, with arrows showing how an evaluation run is triggered and executed.
svg.text: EvalOps platform — how a trigger becomes a graded, stored evaluation run
Dashed boxes are external or optional integrations; solid boxes are the four Aegis Measure services.
